title: Very-Low-Density-Lipoprotein-Triglyceride(VLDL-TG) Metabolism During Acute Hyperglycemia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to estimate the acute effect of hyperglycemia on Very-Low-Density-Lipoprotein-triglyceride(VLDL-TG) secretion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Type 1 diabetes
2. Age 18-50 years

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Smoking
2. Alcohol abuse
3. Use of medications (except insulin in diabetics)
